Proton Torpedoes.ability: Attack (Lock): Spend 1 charge. Change 1 hit result to a critical hit result.
Proton Torpedoes.summary: 4-dice R2-3 attack, converts hit to crit

Plasma Torpedoes.ability: Attack (Lock): Spend 1 charge. During the Neutralize Results step, cancel 1 hit result. After the attack hits, remove 1 shield from the defender.

Ion Torpedoes.ability: Attack (Lock): Spend 1 charge. If this attack hits, spend 1 hit/crit result to cause the defender to suffer 1 ion token. All remaining hit/crit results inflict ion tokens instead of damage.

Advanced Proton Torpedoes.ability: Attack (Lock): Spend 1 charge. Change 1 hit result to a critical hit result.
Advanced Proton Torpedoes.summary: 5-dice R1, converts hit to crit, one shot

Concussion Missiles.ability: Attack (Lock): Spend 1 charge. After this attack hits, each ship at range 0-1 of the defender exposes 1 of its damage cards.
Concussion Missiles.summary: 3-dice R2-3, exposes damage cards on hit

Cluster Missiles.ability: Attack (Lock): Spend 1 charge. After this attack, you may perform this attack as a bonus attack against a different target at range 0-1 of the defender.

Homing Missiles.ability: Attack (Lock): Spend 1 charge. After you declare the defender, the defender may choose to suffer 1 damage. If it does, skip the Attack and Defense Dice steps and the attack is treated as hitting.
Homing Missiles.summary: 4-dice R2-3, guaranteed 1 damage if defender accepts

Proton Rockets.summary: 5-dice R1-2, requires focus instead of lock, one shot

Barrage Rockets.ability: Attack (Focus): Spend 1 charge. If the defender is in your bullseye arc, you may spend 1 or more charges to reroll that many attack dice.

Predator.ability: While you perform a primary attack, if the defender is in your bullseye firing arc, you may reroll 1 attack die.
Predator.summary: Free reroll if target in bullseye

Crack Shot.ability: While you perform a primary attack, if the defender is in your bullseye firing arc, before the Neutralize Results step, you may spend 1 charge to cancel 1 evade result.

Outmaneuver.ability: While you perform a front arc attack, if you are not in the defender's firing arc, the defender rolls 1 fewer defense die.
Outmaneuver.summary: Target -1 agility if not in their arc

Elusive.ability: While you defend, you may spend 1 charge to reroll 1 defense die. After you fully execute a red maneuver, recover 1 charge.
Elusive.summary: Reroll 1 defense die, recharges on red maneuvers

Juke.ability: While you perform an attack, if you have an Evade token, you may change 1 of the defender's evade results to a focus result.
Juke.summary: With evade token, change defender evade to focus

Lone Wolf.ability: While you defend or perform an attack, if there are no other friendly ships at range 0-2, you may spend 1 charge to reroll 1 of your dice.
Lone Wolf.summary: Reroll when no friendlies nearby, recurring charge

Marksmanship.ability: While you perform an attack, if the defender is in your bullseye firing arc, you may change 1 hit result to a critical hit result.
Marksmanship.summary: Change hit to crit if in bullseye

Fearless.ability: While you perform a front arc primary attack, if the attack range is 1 and you are in the defender's front arc, you may change 1 of your results to a hit result.
Fearless.summary: At R1 in mutual arcs, change 1 result to hit

Intimidation.ability: While an enemy ship at range 0 defends, it rolls 1 fewer defense die.

Heroic.ability: While you defend or perform an attack, if you have only blank results, you may reroll any number of your dice.
Heroic.summary: Reroll all dice if all blanks

Daredevil.ability: While you perform a white boost action, you may treat it as red to use the 1 turn template instead.

Expert Handling.ability: After you barrel roll, you may spend 1 charge to remove 1 red/orange token.

Debris Gambit.ability: While you perform a red evade action, if there is an obstacle at range 0-1, treat the action as white instead.

Snap Shot.ability: After an enemy ship executes a maneuver, you may perform this attack against it as a bonus attack. Attack: Your dice cannot be modified.
Snap Shot.summary: Bonus 2-dice attack when enemy moves through, no mods

Trick Shot.ability: While you perform an attack that is obstructed by an obstacle, roll 1 additional attack die.
Trick Shot.summary: +1 attack die when shooting through obstacle

Swarm Tactics.ability: At the start of the Engagement Phase, you may choose 1 friendly ship at range 1. If you do, that ship treats its initiative as equal to yours until the end of the round.
Swarm Tactics.summary: Give initiative to friendly at R1

Sense.ability: During the System Phase, you may choose 1 ship at range 0-1 and look at its dial. If you spend 1 Force, you may choose a ship at range 0-3 instead.
Sense.summary: See enemy dial R0-1, or R0-3 with Force

Hate.ability: After you suffer 1 or more damage, recover that many Force charges.

Heightened Perception.ability: At the start of the Engagement Phase, you may spend 1 Force. If you do, engage at initiative 7 instead of your normal initiative value.
Heightened Perception.summary: Spend Force to engage at I7

Brilliant Evasion.ability: While you defend, if you are not in the attacker's bullseye arc, you may spend 1 Force to change 2 of your focus results to evade results.
Brilliant Evasion.summary: Spend Force, 2 focus to evade if not in bullseye

Supernatural Reflexes.ability: Before you activate, you may spend 1 Force to perform a barrel roll or boost action. Then, if you performed an action you do not have on your action bar, suffer 1 damage.
Supernatural Reflexes.summary: Pre-move reposition, damage if not native

Instinctive Aim.ability: While you perform a special attack, you may spend 1 Force to ignore the Focus or Lock requirement.
Instinctive Aim.summary: Force replaces lock/focus for special weapons

Foresight.ability: After an enemy ship executes a maneuver, you may spend 1 Force to perform this attack against it as a bonus attack. Attack: You may change 1 focus result to a hit result; your dice cannot be modified otherwise.
Foresight.summary: Force-powered bonus attack on enemy move

Precognitive Reflexes.ability: After you reveal your dial, you may spend 1 Force to perform a barrel roll or boost action. Then, if you performed an action you do not have on your action bar, suffer 1 damage. If you do, you cannot perform another action during your activation.

Autoblasters.ability: Attack: If the defender is in your bullseye arc, roll 1 additional die. During the Neutralize Results step, if you are not in the defender's firing arc, evade results do not cancel hit results.
Autoblasters.summary: 2-dice R1-2, +1 in bullseye, hits ignore evades outside arc

Heavy Laser Cannon.ability: Attack: After the Modify Attack Dice step, change all crit results to hit results.

Ion Cannon.ability: Attack: If this attack hits, spend 1 hit or crit result to cause the defender to suffer 1 ion token. All remaining hit/crit results inflict ion tokens instead of damage.

Jamming Beam.ability: Attack: If this attack hits, all hit/crit results inflict jam tokens instead of damage.

Tractor Beam.ability: Attack: If this attack hits, all hit/crit results inflict tractor tokens instead of damage.

Stealth Device.ability: While you defend, if your charge is active, roll 1 additional defense die. After you suffer damage, lose 1 charge.

Afterburners.ability: After you fully execute a speed 3-5 maneuver, you may spend 1 charge to perform a boost action, even while stressed.
Afterburners.summary: Boost after fast maneuver, even stressed

Electronic Baffle.ability: During the End Phase, you may suffer 1 damage to remove 1 red token.
Electronic Baffle.summary: Suffer 1 damage to remove red token

Static Discharge Vanes.ability: Before you would gain 1 ion or jam token, if you are not stressed, you may choose another ship at range 0-1 and gain 1 stress token. If you do, the chosen ship gains that ion or jam token instead.
Static Discharge Vanes.summary: Transfer ion/jam to nearby ship for stress
